title: Ruth 2:2 and 1 Samuel 16:22 — “find favor”, 5th mention of Ruth and David
summary: Two verses about finding favor, each headed by a “5th Mention” label: Ruth 2:2 (the 5th mention of Ruth, with a small 5 after her name) and 1 Samuel 16:22 (the 5th mention of David, with a small 5 after his name). “find favor” and “found favor” are shown in larger type.

text.text: 2 And Ruth⁵ the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Please let me go to the field and glean among the ears of grain after one in whose sight I may find favor.” And she said to her, “Go, my daughter.”
22 Saul sent to Jesse, saying, “Let David⁵ now stand before me, for he has found favor in my sight.

numbers.note: 5th mention of Ruth (superscript 5 after Ruth in Ruth 2:2)
5th mention of David (superscript 5 after David in 1 Samuel 16:22)
